title: Bounce Landing
description: Quả bóng rơi xuống nảy ba lần thấp dần, mỗi lần chạm đất lại bẹp ra, vừa nảy vừa trôi sang phải.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio bounce-land, written here): Drop from 106 px (demo; recipe 130) to the floor: fall 266 ms (parabola), then bounces 52 / 22 / 8 px high lasting 225 / 142 / 86 ms (parabolic arcs), last contact at 719 ms (bounce.out timing). At each contact squash scaleY by 32 / 20 / 10 / 4 % (scaleX = 1/scaleY) as a 100 ms triangle centred on the contact, origin bottom. Drifts 140 px right over 780 ms (linear); shadow shrinks with height. Params: drop: độ cao (130 px) · bounces: độ cao nảy (52 / 22 / 8 px) · squash (0.32 / 0.2 / 0.1 / 0.04) · drift (140 px). The last contact lands at 0.719 s, the bounce.out timing.
